Users

Manage who has access to the Mint Platforms admin console.

Role access levels

Super Admin — Full access — users, settings, billing, everything
Admin — Full access except user management and settings
Finance — Pricing, quotes, invoices and billing only
Support — View-only: dashboard, clients, leads, applications

The first Super Admin is created directly in the Supabase Auth dashboard. Password reset links are valid for 24 hours.
